scope.method: Same original saved source records, text, ordered images, target as_of, provider and selected route; changed prompt/schema descriptions and field order. One bounded HTTP attempt per case. No rewriting or filling of model outputs.
scope.selection: Five residual cases selected after the first nine-case replay. The unresolved Digital Mashka transport timeout was not retried. This is not a random sample or provider benchmark.
scope.artifact_paths: Every source, original and second_pass file path is relative to the second replay artifact root (artifact 13129585528). Every first_pass file path is relative to the first replay artifact root (artifact 13128188275). Review_source identifies a separate reviewer report by filename. provenance.schema_comparison_method: Ignore description annotations and ordering within required arrays; compare every other schema keyword and value. Property-key ordering is not significant.
provenance.canonical_source_records_hash_format: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, compact comma/colon separators, no final newline. Contract hashes are retained separately exactly as recorded.

counts.interpretation: The last two counts distinguish material meaning change from a structural contract violation. They are not interchangeable severity labels or a provider accuracy estimate. Minor findings remain in individual reviews.

integrity_and_accounting.production_items_invariance_evidence: Independent complete remote commit diff (all 10+/10- lines match exactly the local ledger-only diff) corroborates checksummed runner invariants. source_records.conditions_text:
Как получить подарок
Нажмите «Получить подарок» и вы получите SMS с промокодом.
На сайте или в приложении «Додо Пицца» добавьте в корзину позиции на сумму от 1190 рублей.
В поле «Промокод» введите код из SMS - пицца за 1 рубль появится в корзине.
При заказе в ресторане покажите SMS с промокодом сотруднику.
Условия предложения
Промокод действует на доставку, самовывоз и на заказ в ресторане во всех пиццериях «Додо Пицца» в следующих городах: Санкт‑Петербург (кроме Петергофа, Пушкина, Ломоносова, Колпина, Красного Села, Кронштадта, Сестрорецка и Павловска), Мурино (Лаврики и Новое Девяткино), Парголово (Бугры, Корабсельки, Мистолово, Парнас, Порошкино, Энколово, Юкки), Шушары.
Акция также распространяется на пиццерии Мурина, Кудрова и Шушар.
Один абонент может получить и активировать не более одного промокода в одну календарную неделю.
Акция не действует при покупке комбо и на дополнительные ингредиенты.
Акция действует, пока товар есть в наличии.
Промокод не является средством платежа, не выдается в денежном эквиваленте и не может быть обменян на товары или услуги, не предусмотренные условиями акции.
Все претензии по качеству продукции направляются продавцу, которым является Общество с ограниченной ответственностью «Додо Франчайзинг» (ОГРН: 1131101001844, ИНН: 1101140415, КПП: 110101001), юр. адрес: 167001, Республика Коми, г. Сыктывкар, Октябрьский проспект, д. 16.

limits: This report embeds exactly the five accepted second-pass extracted JSON objects without repairs. Provider response envelopes and nonfinal internal generation content are excluded.
The five source_records are copied without changes from public frozen source evidence. Their presence does not establish personal eligibility or current public availability.
The first-pass report remains unchanged. Four Seasons had no accepted first-pass output; its first-pass rejection is not replaced by the second-pass success.

Five completed schema-valid responses are not five semantically approved records. Rakovaya still changes an independent benefit into a condition; Giorgio still merges two benefits. Minor source-fidelity findings remain elsewhere.

A count of offers is a count of extracted objects, not a completeness or truth score. The same four cases completed in both passes contain six objects in each; Four Seasons adds four newly accepted objects in the second pass.

Ledger verification is a distinct engineering result, not semantic approval. Full production item snapshots were not included in the artifact, so item digests were not independently recomputed by this aggregation.
Recorded provider costs/credit deltas are measurement values, not an assertion about an invoiced payment. Null reported cost remains unknown.
One before/after generation does not isolate the prompt change from generation variability and does not establish generalization to untested offers or providers.
No third restaurant retry, fallback provider, model expansion, source-specific repair, or Sheets publication was performed by this audit.
